chapter_seo_title: Ji Ning vs the Bone-Slaying Needle – Desolate Era Chapter 308
chapter_meta_description: An arena duel turns deadly when a Loose Immortal assassin strikes Ji Ning with a legendary Bone-Slaying Immortal Needle. Can even his Domain of the Dao stop it?
og_title: The Bone-Slaying Immortal Needle Strikes – Desolate Era Chapter 308
og_description: Xiao Lang’s victory over Bo Yan Fairy is just the calm before the storm. A Loose Immortal from the Shaoyan clan launches a desperate assassination on Ji Ning!
twitter_description: A Loose Immortal throws a Bone-Slaying Needle at Ji Ning. His only hope is to block it with six swords and the Domain of the Dao!

lore_anchors.definition: A powerful, first-grade flame technique that manifests as blazing, blood-colored fire used in combat and formation attacks.
A defensive formation that manifests as a looping, jade-green ribbon, creating a water-based barrier highly resistant to fire and physical attacks.
A legendary, cursed assassination treasure capable of killing or severely wounding even Loose Immortals; its power lies in focused penetration of both body and soul.
A cultivator who failed their Heavenly Tribulation but survived by abandoning their physical body. They are cursed with periodic tribulations and have no hope of further advancement.
The physical projection of a cultivator's complete comprehension of their Dao, turning the surrounding area into a realm of their power; normally achievable only at the Primal Daoist stage and above.
A binding oath sworn on the laws of the universe; breaking it results in immediate soul annihilation from karmic backlash.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is a Bone-Slaying Immortal Needle?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It’s a legendary cursed assassination treasure that can kill or cripple even Loose Immortals by focusing all its power into a single, soul-penetrating strike.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is a Loose Immortal a good assassin?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Loose Immortals have no hope of advancing and are already doomed to periodic tribulations, making them perfect disposable killers—especially when bound by a Heavenly Dao Oath.

cultural_notes_faq.q: How is Ji Ning able to use a Domain of the Dao?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Ji Ning’s comprehension of the Sword Dao is so profound that he can project it physically, a feat normally impossible for a Wanxiang Adept, marking him as a true monster genius.
The Floating Cloud Immortal is almost certainly a death-dancer of the Shaoyan clan, sent to eliminate Ji Ning before the Immortal Fortunes Assembly.
